question: Which state in India has become the first to be officially declared “free of extreme poverty” by its Chief Minister on November 1, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kerala has become the first state in India to be officially declared "free of extreme poverty," with the announcement on November 1, 2025, by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The announcement comes after Kerala’s successful extreme poverty eradication programme, launched in 2021, which aimed to uplift families living in severe economic distress.**
 
• **The programme focused on integrating local resources for housing, food, health, and income support to ensure long-term rehabilitation for the poor.**
 
• **Kerala’s success in eliminating extreme poverty is attributed to its investments in human development, such as high literacy rates, universal healthcare, and decentralized governance.**
 
• **Kerala's achievement aligns with India's Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 1 — ending poverty in all its forms and sets a model for other states to follow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Extreme Poverty Definition**__

 __
 
• Households lacking access to basic income, shelter, food, and health.
 
• Excluded from social welfare schemes due to lack of documentation or isolation.
 
• Often stuck in multi-generational poverty with minimal upward mobility.
 
 
 
• **Why Kerala Leads in Social Development**__
 __
 
• High literacy rates and access to universal healthcare.
 
• Empowered panchayats and strong local governance systems.
 
• Proactive civil society and effective implementation of welfare schemes.
 
 
 
• **National and Policy Significance**__
 __
 
• Kerala’s achievement serves as a model for other states in poverty alleviation.
 
• It aligns with India’s commitment to SDG 1, contributing to global poverty reduction goals.
 
• It emphasizes the need for updated national poverty data and multi-dimensional poverty measurement.
 
 
 
• **Next Steps for Kerala**__
 
 
• Continue monitoring vulnerable households to prevent relapse into poverty.
 
• Focus on skill development and job-linking programs for long-term sustainability.
 
• Strengthen safety nets and support for marginalized communities.
